//: Type checking only. Node 26 runs the .ts sources directly by STRIPPING types, never by compiling them, so this
config must describe that runtime rather than a build: noEmit, .ts kept in the import paths, and
erasableSyntaxOnly to refuse the syntax stripping cannot erase (enum, namespace, parameter properties, decorators,
import assignment). Without that flag the check would pass on code Node then refuses to run.
Run it with `npm run typecheck`; Task 11's acceptance gate calls the same script.
